must_reads.title: Shopify 把 Direct checkout 改名为 agentic checkout，并已对 ChatGPT 开放：符合条件的店铺默认开启
must_reads.matched_topic: AI Agent 电商落地 / Checkout 设置
must_reads.summary: 本轮已打开 Shopify 官方 Changelog（2026-11-23）和帮助页 Selling on ChatGPT。官方写明：Direct checkout 在所有 AI 渠道改称 agentic checkout，现已对 ChatGPT 开放；AI agent 可用店铺的 Shopify checkout 代客下单，订单照常出现在 admin。符合条件的店铺，在 Manage for me 或 Automatically enable new channels 打开时默认启用，既有 opt-out 仍有效，其他渠道设置不变。帮助页补充：需向美国顾客销售（店铺可在美国以外）、商品需符合 Shopify Catalog、须同意 Agentic Storefronts 补充条款，并在 Settings > Policies 填好服务条款、隐私政策和退款政策。默认关闭的情形：ChatGPT 的 Catalog 访问被关、Sales channels > Agentic 里 Automatically enable new channels 被关、或店铺在 Agentic plan。后台路径：Sales channels > Agentic → 如显示 Manage for me 先切到 Manual → ChatGPT → 开关 Agentic checkout → Save。关掉 agentic checkout 不会让商品从 ChatGPT 发现里消失，也不影响 Shop skill / Shop App for ChatGPT 的下单；完全不想被 Catalog 分发时，关 Catalog 访问最多可能要 7 天才能停止共享。官方写明在 ChatGPT 销售没有额外费用，只付常规支付处理费。法律披露写在商品描述前 6,000 字符；B2B-only 商品不支持。

supporting.angle: 帮助页：Selling on ChatGPT（资格、默认开/关条件、后台步骤、Shop skill 不受影响、Catalog 关闭最多 7 天）

topics.angle: 本轮已打开 PPC Land 11/23 原文。它引用的是 ASGTG 创始人在 LinkedIn 公开的 Amazon Services 卖家通知，本轮没有打开 Seller Central 原件或公开帮助页，所以角度里的通知原文都标明是「PPC Land 转述的通知措辞」，不是我直接读到的官方后台。通知称：2026-11-26 起，Victoria's Secret 不再允许第三方在 Amazon.com 上架，只保留持有该品牌 Brand Representative 角色的卖家；理由是 VS 只做 DTC、不走批发。PPC Land 还写：卖家可以在截止前卖完剩余库存或删除空 listing，Amazon 称此次移除不计入 Account Health Rating；通知指向 Resolve No Wholesale Distribution (NWD) errors 5465 and 6045，但该帮助页没有公开版本可核。30 分钟动作：1）在 Seller Central 通知和邮箱里搜 Victoria's Secret、No Wholesale Distribution、NWD、5465、6045，先确认自己有没有收到同类通知，不要只凭二手报道停售其他品牌。2）若通知属实且你有 VS 库存，赶在 11/26 前处理剩余单位或清空空 listing，并单独记下「这次移除据称不影响 AHR」，不要和普通政策违规混在一起看健康度。3）顺手扫一遍其他品牌有没有 10 月以来的 NWD 通知——PPC Land 说卖家当时已在另一家家喻户晓品牌上见过同类规则——但不要外推成「所有第三方品牌货都会在感恩节被下架」。在登录后台看到同一通知之前，不要把「全站点第三方 VS 下架」写成已由官方帮助页确认的全量规则。
topics.reasoning: 命中 Admission (a)(c)：若通知属实，11/26 会改变谁能上架该品牌，30 分钟可先查通知并处理库存。platform_family: Amazon（今日 1/2）。来源置信度：中；需后台复核后再写成确定性规则，当前为条件性操作候选。未复用昨日 Attribution 28 天或 Brand Store Agent slug。非 D4。未为凑满 5 条再加弱题。Bingge 评分≥70。

drafts.text:
Shopify just turned on agentic checkout for ChatGPT.

That means three things.

First, if your store is eligible and you left Manage for me or Automatically enable new channels on, the setting may already be on. You did not have to opt in.

Second, turning off Agentic checkout stops agents from completing checkout with tools such as UCP and WebMCP. It does not hide your products in ChatGPT, and it does not stop checkouts that use the Shop skill or the Shop App for ChatGPT.

Third, the official path is Sales channels > Agentic. If it says Manage for me, switch to Manual, open ChatGPT, and then save the switch you actually want.

Source: Shopify Changelog and the Selling on ChatGPT help page, November 23, 2026.

drafts.text:
Most people will read Google's new back-button FAQ as a problem for publishers only. That is the wrong way to use it.

Google said today it added an FAQ to its back button hijacking spam policy. The rule itself is not new.

The useful part is the liability line: you can still import code hosted by ad platforms. Google acts on pages that actually trap the back button. The same policy covers Discover, and it covers visits that start on social or other non-Search channels, as long as the hijack happens inside a browser. Open-in-app hand-offs are out of scope.

Before Black Friday traffic arrives, click Back on your ad landing pages and on pages that get social or Discover visits. If a tag is inserting an interstitial, disable that tag and test again.

Source: Google Search Central documentation update and spam policies, last updated 2026-11-23 UTC.

drafts.text:
This morning's market snapshot was taken at about 9:20am ET, while US stocks were still marked closed, so treat NVDA at 165.05 (+31.48%) and SHOP at 134.30 (+8.55%) as Monday's close or the pre-open quote, not Tuesday's open.

BTC was near 60,350, down about 5.4% over 24 hours. Crypto Fear & Greed sat at 9 (Extreme fear). The ETF daily flow print was about -$569.7 million. That is context, not a trade.

The operator job this week is still checkout and listing control, not the tape. Shopify has turned on agentic checkout for ChatGPT by default for eligible stores. Amazon sellers with Victoria's Secret inventory should look for a November 26 removal notice before they treat Black Friday as a normal sell-through day.

Sources: Day1 Global snapshot at 2026-11-24T14:20:38Z; Shopify Changelog (Nov 23); PPC Land report of an Amazon Services notice (Nov 23).

cross_opportunities.label: Shopify agentic checkout × ChatGPT 发现层
cross_opportunities.text: Shopify 把代客下单做成可关的 Agentic checkout，但帮助页写得很清楚：关开关不等于退出 ChatGPT 发现，也不等于挡住 Shop skill。这和 Adweek 所写「ChatGPT agent 自写查询、广告主看不见」是同一条零售入口的两端——一边是你的 checkout 开关，一边是你看不见的查询。黑五前先核对开关和 Catalog 访问，再决定要不要另外处理商品描述前 6,000 字符的披露。

cross_opportunities.label: Walmart 对 Muse 打开 Agent Gateway × Amazon/eBay 拦截 agent 浏览
cross_opportunities.text: The Verge 写 Walmart 让 Muse 走 Agent Profile 代客下单，并对比 Amazon 和 eBay 拦截 AI agent 浏览。Shopify 同一窗口则把 agent checkout 做成默认开启的可选项。交叉点不是「AI 购物到来」的空话，而是各平台把控制权放在不同位置：Walmart 在消费者 Agent Profile 的限额，Shopify 在商家的 Agentic checkout / Catalog 开关，Amazon 仍偏拦截。对卖家更可执行的是 Shopify 开关；Walmart 侧本轮没有找到 Marketplace 可改字段。
